Gotcha: brain_* failing with "403 Resource not accessible by personal access token" means the Vercel BRAIN_GITHUB_TOKEN (fine-grained) lacks Contents: Read and write. Edit the token's permissions on GitHub; the token value stays the same, so no Vercel change or redeploy is needed.
